blocks.content: In this course, you'll build a complete portfolio page from a design, section by section, the same way you'd do it on a real team.
By the end, you'll be able to:

items: read a design and extract what actually matters
plan the HTML structure before you touch CSS
match spacing, typography, and layout without guessing
spot and fix mismatches between the design and the browser
make changes confidently without breaking the page

blocks.content: Requirement: You should already know the basics of HTML and CSS.
Next, we'll do a quick Figma warm-up, only what you need as a developer.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
